name: Demo_resource_EA
summary: This EA demonstrates the use of the #resource directive in MQL5 to embed bitmap image files into a compiled executable. It creates a bitmap label button on the chart that toggles between a euro and dollar image when pressed and released.
summary_zh: 该EA演示了MQL5中#resource指令的使用方法，将位图文件嵌入到编译后的可执行文件中。它在图表上创建一个位图标签按钮，按下和释放时分别显示欧元和美元图像。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个交易策略，而是一个MQL5资源嵌入的演示工具。它的核心功能是展示#resource指令如何将外部BMP图像文件编译进EA中，从而实现自包含的可执行文件。入场和出场条件不适用于此EA，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。该EA在OnInit中创建OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL对象，绑定到图表右上角，并加载两张位图资源分别对应按钮的按下和释放状态。在OnDeinit中删除图表对象以保持清洁。代码中还包含了资源定义的正确和错误示例注释，作为教学参考。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a demonstration utility for MQL5 resource embedding. Its core function is to show how the #resource directive compiles external BMP image files into the EA executable, enabling self-contained deployment. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are similarly not applicable. The EA creates an OBJ_BITMAP_LABEL object in OnInit, anchors it to the upper-right corner of the chart, and loads two bitmap resources corresponding to the button's pressed and released states respectively. OnDeinit removes the chart object for clean teardown. The code also includes commented examples of correct and incorrect resource definitions for educational reference.

parameters.name: #resource euro.bmp
parameters.description: 按钮按下状态的欧元位图资源路径
parameters.description_en: Euro bitmap resource path for pressed button

parameters.name: #resource dollar.bmp
parameters.description: 按钮释放状态的美元位图资源路径
parameters.description_en: Dollar bitmap resource path for released button

pros: 清晰演示了#resource指令的用法，是MQL5资源嵌入的良好教学示例
代码结构简洁，OnInit/OnDeinit生命周期管理完整，对象创建和删除配对良好
包含错误检查和错误信息输出，便于调试和学习资源加载失败的排查方法
注释中提供了正确和错误的资源定义对比，帮助开发者避免常见陷阱
pros_en: Clearly demonstrates #resource directive usage, serving as an excellent MQL5 resource embedding tutorial
Clean code structure with complete OnInit/OnDeinit lifecycle management and proper object creation/deletion pairing
Includes error checking and error message output, facilitating debugging and learning how to troubleshoot resource loading failures
Comments provide correct vs incorrect resource definition comparisons, helping developers avoid common pitfalls
cons: 不执行任何交易功能，仅作为演示用途，实用性有限
缺少输入参数（input变量），硬编码的资源路径和位置参数缺乏灵活性
没有对按钮点击事件的处理（OnChartEvent），按钮虽可切换但无实际功能响应
仅支持BMP格式，不支持更现代的图像格式如PNG
cons_en: Does not perform any trading function, serves only as a demonstration with limited practical utility
Lacks input parameters (input variables), hardcoded resource paths and position settings reduce flexibility
No OnChartEvent handler for button click events, so the button toggles visually but has no functional response
Only supports BMP format, not more modern image formats like PNG
improvements: 添加OnChartEvent事件处理，使按钮点击能触发实际操作（如切换交易品种、改变显示模式等）
将资源路径和对象位置参数改为input变量，提高可配置性和复用性
improvements_en: Add OnChartEvent handler so button clicks trigger actual operations (e.g., switching symbols, changing display modes)
Convert resource paths and object position parameters to input variables for better configurability and reusability

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，不存在交易风险
资源文件路径硬编码，若文件缺失会导致资源加载失败但不会造成资金损失
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, posing no trading risk
Hardcoded resource file paths may cause loading failures if files are missing, but no financial loss can occur

summary_en: This EA demonstrates the use of the #resource directive in MQL5 to embed bitmap image files into a compiled executable. It creates a bitmap label button on the chart that toggles between a euro and dollar image when pressed and released.
